arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = "table"

SELECT 'bookings' AS kind, json_group_array(json_object('id',booking_id,'request',request_id,'flight',flight_id,'passenger',passenger_id,'amount',amount_cents,'status',status,'reference',client_reference,'confirmed_at',confirmed_at)) AS rows FROM bookings UNION ALL SELECT 'charges',json_group_array(json_object('id',charge_id,'booking',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step)) FROM charges UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_group_array(json_object('id',event_id,'booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts)) FROM outbox UNION ALL SELECT 'flights',json_group_array(json_object('id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version)) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_group_array(json_object('key',key,'value',value)) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_holds',json_group_array(json_object('id',hold_id,'flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step)) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_events',json_group_array(json_object('id',event_id,'request',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step)) FROM customer_events

SELECT 'pending' kind,json_group_array(json_object('id',b.booking_id,'request',b.request_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'reference',b.client_reference,'charge',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'charge_step',c.created_step)) rows FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_events',json_group_array(json_object('request',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step)) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',value)) FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_group_array(json_object('key',key,'value',value)) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'logs',json_group_array(json_object('id',id,'service',service,'path',path,'status',status,'message',message)) FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs WHERE service IN ('booking','payment','pricing') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 45)

SELECT 'pending' kind,json_group_array(json_object('booking',b.booking_id,'request',b.request_id,'cancel_step',e.step,'reference',b.client_reference,'confirmed_twin',(SELECT t.booking_id FROM bookings t WHERE t.client_reference=b.client_reference AND t.status='confirmed'),'charge',c.charge_id,'state',c.state,'key',c.idempotency_key,'charge_step',c.created_step)) rows FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN customer_events e ON e.request_id=b.request_id LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'flights',json_group_array(json_object('id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'version',version)) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'early_logs',json_group_array(json_object('id',id,'service',service,'path',path,'status',status,'message',message)) FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs ORDER BY id LIMIT 25)
